source.title: Derry Journal, 6 June 1955, p. 5 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Londonderry, 1955 (Returning Officer's notice)")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Derry Journal 6 Jun 1955 p5 (page image read, British Newspaper Archive copy): no poll in this division; the person entered in column 6 duly elected.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Banagher (Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). The other twelve divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Derry Journal, 6 June 1955, p. 5) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Liberties (Upper)' to Liberties Upper (13 Nov 2026, by the owner's rule for division spellings: the official or DED-map name where there is one, otherwise the spelling most rounds use): the DED maps of 1930-69 (LIBERTIES UPPER) spell it Liberties Upper. This round was filed under the spelling 'Liberties (Upper)', a form of the division's name it keeps as an alias.
